# Conformance cases known not to pass yet, one identifier per line.
#
# This file is a RATCHET, enforced by internal/conformance:
#
#   listed and failing    -> reported as pending, build stays green
#   listed and PASSING    -> build FAILS: delete the line
#   unlisted and failing  -> build FAILS: a regression
#
# So the file can only shrink, and progress cannot be silently lost. During P0
# it shrinks commit by commit, and its diff is the progress report.
#
# It is empty because nothing is failing. pkg/format is registered and every
# case the parser can answer passes; the cases it cannot answer yet — the ones
# asserting metadata, which P0.2 and P0.3 bring — are reported as skipped, and
# a skip is never counted as a pass. So an entry here means a real failure that
# somebody has accepted for now, and the file should stay empty until one is.
